decisions.question: Who should confirm an applicant’s identity before the application can be submitted?
decisions.selected_description: One authorized staff member verifies the evidence and records an auditable decision.
decisions.scope: One qualified current staff verifier; exact authoritative evidence source and protected handler remain implementation dependencies

decisions.question: May staff withdraw an unfinished application before the child’s identity has been verified?
decisions.selected_description: Keep the withdrawn draft and its history without creating a Person record solely to close it.
decisions.supersedes: Only the older NULL-Person-exclusively-DRAFT terminal restriction; verified identity before SUBMITTED remains binding

decisions.question: When should newly published admission rules start applying to new submissions?
decisions.selected_description: Rules take effect when published; existing submitted applications retain their original rules.
decisions.scope: Trusted server publication instant; no scheduled/backdated publication or retroactive submitted-application policy rewrite
